description: Plain-text GitHub Actions logs. Provide `job_id` (preferred) for GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/logs, or `run_id` to get the logs of that workflow run's failed jobs (conclusion failure or timed_out, latest attempt, at most 3), each under a header naming the job; a run with no failed jobs answers its job list instead. Whole logs past ~50 MiB cannot be fetched; pass `tail_bytes` to get only the end of each log, where a failure usually is (with `run_id` it defaults to the last 64 KiB per job). Expired logs answer 410.

job_id.description: Job id from list_workflow_run_jobs. Give this or run_id, not both.

run_id.description: Workflow run id; returns the logs of the run's failed jobs.

tail_bytes.description: Return only the last N bytes of each log.
